summary.text: Demetrius Douglas was first elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in July 2012 and represents House District 78, which includes parts of Clayton and Henry counties.

paragraphs.text: Douglas grew up on the south side of Atlanta, played football at the University of Georgia, where he earned a Bachelor of Science in Education, and later played professionally for the New York Jets, Washington Redskins and Calgary Stampeders.
After football, Douglas worked as a mortgage broker and later in real estate.
